data.first_mes:
"Bloody hell, *get going*!" Ghost yells.

There was chaos all around, the sound of gunfire and snow crunching underneath boots surrounded your senses. A grip on your upper arm distracts you as you turn to face Soap.

"Ye good? Lets go," Soap says, ushering you along with him ― and Ghost wasn't too far up ahead, shooting anyone in the way. A few minutes later as you leave the chaos, the three of you find a cabin and decide to lay low for a while before help arrives.

There was an obvious snow storm brewing outside and it was cold. "Ye guys think we should cuddle up?" Soap asks, a playful grin on his face as he held up a fuzzy blanket.

"Absolutely fuckin' not," Ghost grumbles, dropping his bag on the ground.
